_schema.purpose: ZERO-RECORD manifest fixture: the header alone, no records. Proves the D-09 fail-closed leg -- an empty input set exits 2, never 0. Silence is never success.
_schema.source_text_convention: Stored EXACTLY as read but WITHOUT its line terminator, i.e. as produced by str.splitlines() -- identical to the real manifest, because Phase 159's oracle compares against splitlines() output.

pre_sweep_shas.note: A DELIBERATE PLACEHOLDER. The unit test builds a throwaway git repository at run time and passes the real revision with --pre-sweep-sha, which is exactly why the pre-sweep revision is an argv argument: argv must beat the header, because Phase 159 maps a COMPOSITE pre-154 -> post-158 diff whose old side is not the revision any manifest was generated at. A tool that trusted this placeholder would fail to read the pre-sweep blob and exit 2.

_schema.expected_map: 20 old lines -> 15 new lines. Two SEPARATED deletion blocks (old 4-5 and old 11-13) so the map contains a CHAIN: map[15]=10 AND map[10]=8. A single-block fixture cannot produce a chain and would pass even against a blind implementation (research Pitfall 3).
